title: Link replay exhaustion lifetime is off by roughly 140x
description: Correctness review: spec/02-physical-link.md:317-327 defines one finite 24-bit counter with 16,777,216 tuples and no wrap. Lines 413-415 claim that at 10 packets/sec the epoch wraps in about 7.5 years. The actual lifetime is 16,777,216/10 = 1,677,721.6 seconds = 19.42 days (about 194.18 days at 1 pkt/s). This materially misstates mandatory key-rotation/provisioning cadence. Correct the arithmetic and wording (the terminal counter exhausts; it does not wrap).
